auth.signin.password: Account password, not a physical object
auth.signin.forgot_password: Link to recover account access, not literally forgetting
auth.signup.submit: Create a user account, not a financial account
auth.signup.referral_label: A code someone shared to invite the user; marketing/referral program, not a doctor's referral
sessions.actions.new: Record a past tutoring session; 'log' is a verb meaning to write down, not the noun
sessions.actions.new_short: Tutoring session, not a browser session
sessions.title_new: Log a tutoring session that already happened
sessions.fields.subject: School subject like Maths or English, not email subject or any other sense
sessions.fields.topic: What the lesson covered, not a discussion thread
sessions.fields.homework: Work the student does at home between lessons; noun, not verb 'to homework'
sessions.fields.next_focus: What to cover in the next lesson, not a camera focus
sessions.fields.tutor: Person who teaches privately, not a legal guardian
students.title_list: People the tutor teaches, K-12 children typically
students.subtitle: People the tutor works with — students and their families
students.tabs.track: To follow progress over time, not a racetrack or song
invoices.title_list: Bills issued to parents for tutoring; noun
invoices.columns.billed_to: The parent or household paying the invoice
invoices.actions.batch: Create one invoice per family across many students at once; 'batch' = group, not cooking
invoices.batch.period: Time window like 'this week' or 'this month', not a punctuation mark or menstrual period
messages.title_list: In-app messages between tutor and parent, not the noun 'message' in other senses
dashboard.sections.invoicing.cta: Open the invoice-creation screen for multiple families
dashboard.sections.homework.overdue: Past its due date; not the verb 'to overdue'
common.nav.calendar: Schedule of sessions, like a wall calendar
common.nav.lesson_plans: Documents a tutor writes to prepare for a lesson
common.nav.payouts: Money paid out from the business to a tutor employee
common.nav.settings: App configuration page, not the verb 'to set'
common.nav.billing: Subscription payment for Crestio itself, not invoices for parents
common.status.draft: Not yet sent; applies to invoices and messages
common.status.void: Cancelled invoice that no longer needs payment
parent.student.tabs.updates: Short notes from the tutor about the child
emails.wrapper.open_in_crestio: Button that opens the Crestio web app from the email
